definition: SAP S/4HANA/Fiori or GUI changes break bot selectors or screen flows
include_when: Post mentions changed screens fields buttons layouts element IDs selectors CV anchors or click paths
exclude_when: General SAP issue without bot impact
example_indicators: selector changed; Fiori tile moved; button renamed; SAP GUI screen changed

definition: Underlying SAP transaction tables fields APIs or business objects changed after migration
include_when: Post mentions table/field/transaction/API/BAPI/OData changes affecting automation
exclude_when: Only UI wording or layout changed
example_indicators: transaction replaced; field missing; table changed; OData endpoint changed

definition: Login SSO roles environments certificates or access paths changed
include_when: Post discusses credentials SSO MFA roles environments URLs or connection failures
exclude_when: Generic bot error without access context
example_indicators: new SSO; role missing; VPN; certificate; DEV/QAS/PRD mismatch

definition: Bots fail because response times waits schedules or system stability changed
include_when: Post mentions timeout latency batch windows queue failure retry rates
exclude_when: One-off user mistake unrelated to migration
example_indicators: timeout; page load slow; intermittent; queue retry; job failed

definition: Concrete remediation for adapting bots after migration
include_when: Post describes refactor rebuild selectors APIs test suite monitoring exception handling or CV
example_indicators: rebuild workflow; switch to API; add waits; use Fiori activities; regression tests

definition: Organizational process for managing bot changes during SAP migration
include_when: Post mentions CoE release management stakeholder coordination documentation hypercare or controls
example_indicators: change freeze; UAT; bot inventory; owner signoff; hypercare

definition: Operational consequences or benefits of bot adaptation
include_when: Post includes time saved cost downtime SLA backlog accuracy or productivity measures
exclude_when: Technical issue with no business outcome
example_indicators: hours saved; processing delay; invoice backlog; SLA breach; reduced manual work

definition: Decision to retire retain refactor rebuild replace or redesign bots
include_when: Post discusses choosing whether a bot should survive migration or be replaced
example_indicators: retire bot; rebuild from scratch; move to API; process redesign
